findings.subject: Literature in English
findings.concept: An aside is a brief remark directed to the audience and conventionally unheard by other characters
findings.question_a: In a play, an aside is a brief remark that is usually:
options_a: Heard by the audience but presumed unheard by other characters on stage
Printed only after the final scene
Used to describe the setting in a novel
findings.question_b: In drama, an aside is a speech that is
options_b: heard by the audience but conventionally not by the other characters on stage.
always delivered by every character together.
spoken only by the narrator outside the play.
findings.reason: Both define the same dramatic convention and use the same audience-versus-other-characters distinction.

findings.subject: Biology
findings.concept: Platelets are the blood components responsible for initiating clotting and forming a plug
findings.question_a: Which blood component is especially important in forming a platelet plug during blood clotting?
findings.question_b: Which component of blood is primarily responsible for clotting?
findings.reason: Both ask for the same blood component responsible for the initial clotting plug: platelets.

findings.subject: Government
findings.concept: Legislative committees examine bills and public issues in detail and report to the legislature
findings.question_a: A legislative committee is mainly established to:
options_a: Examine specific matters in detail and report to the chamber
